quarterly_data.signal: Ultra Clean's 10-K says approximately 95.7% of fiscal 2025 revenue came from the semiconductor industry (IDM, memory, foundry, OEM and sub-tier suppliers) and that it is anticipating a period of historically elevated demand driven by growth in artificial intelligence. Capital expenditures were approximately $50.3 million in fiscal 2025 and $63.5 million in fiscal 2024, primarily for manufacturing facility investments in the United States, Ireland and Malaysia and IT infrastructure; listed future capital needs include expansion of manufacturing in Malaysia.
quarterly_data.figure: 95.7% of FY2025 revenue from semiconductor; capex $50.3 million (FY2025) vs $63.5 million (FY2024)
